method: Applies TF-IDF weighting and BM-25 algorithm for Myanmar news retrieval.
key_assumptions: TF-IDF and BM-25 are effective for information retrieval in specific linguistic contexts.
main_contribution: Evaluates TF-IDF and BM-25 for improving relevance and precision in Myanmar news retrieval.

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: Focuses on TF-IDF and BM-25 for Myanmar news retrieval, unrelated to temporal versioning or regulatory QA.
relation_to_idea.basis: Title indicates TF-IDF and BM-25 application.
